messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Region=us-east-1 service=generation stream=true metric=p95_latency value=610ms (SLO=250ms) p99=1.9s (SLO=1s) | error-rate=0.9% | note=spike started ~10:12 UTC

emma (oncall): ack. i'm on it. opening triage. Sasha, can you confirm runtime health?

sasha (eng-runtime): seeing large variance across worker pods. some pods have huge prefill write bursts, others idle. KV write queue depth high. suspect kv cache fragmentation + prefill hot-shard imbalance.

li (eng-sre): traces show streaming stalls where server-held prefill loop blocks for 80-200ms while searching for free slot. decode path looks normal in many traces but streaming chunk emit delayed.

emma (oncall): customer impact? marta?

marta (customer-success): three enterprise customers reported degraded streaming (partial responses stalled mid-stream) and two internal smoke tests failed. CS flagged Customer-B as high priority. they want mitigation ETA.

devin (eng-infra): autoscaler attempted to provision new GPU workers but quota exhausted in us-east-1; suggested fallback: spin additional CPU prefill-only pods to offload writes, then route streaming to existing GPU pool more evenly.

sasha (eng-runtime): quick mitigation options: A) throttle prefill concurrency per-shard; B) enable per-request prefill cap on context window; C) temporary client-side stream buffer to keep chunks flowing (harder). I can apply A/B now.

emma (oncall): do A and B, stage to a single AZ first. Also create temporary route for enterprise customers to low-memory model variant if needed.

sasha (eng-runtime): applying config: `kubectl patch cm runtime-config -n runtime --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/kv/prefill/max_parallel","value":2},{"op":"replace","path":"/kv/prefill/max_context_tokens","value":1024}]'`

sasha (eng-runtime): patched on us-east-1a canary pool. rolling restart of 6 pods. logs show prefill concurrency drop from 12->2.

li (eng-sre): monitoring: eviction.rate droppped 55% in canary, fragmentation_ratio declined from 0.58 -> 0.43. p95 in canary reduced from 610ms -> 240ms. overall p95 across region still 410ms.

emma (oncall): good progress. marta, relay to Customer-B: we have a staged mitigation; ask them to try again, expect partial improvement in ~5-10m.

marta (customer-success): messaging sent. they asked if we can give a painless rollback plan if change causes regressions.

sasha (eng-runtime): rollback is just revert of the two config keys and rolling restart. i have a patch queued: `kubectl apply -f runtime-config/revert-prefill.yaml` ready.

devin (eng-infra): note: because GPU scaling blocked, we should avoid triggering heavy bursty model loads. recommending adding soft rate-limit per-customer until quotas resolved.

li (eng-sre): deployed soft alert to ops: ALERT if fragmentation_ratio > 0.45 && eviction.rate > 400 -> escalate to P0. Also adding a dashboard for shard imbalance heatmap.

sasha (eng-runtime): after regional rollout of the prefill throttle (us-east-1b/1c), metrics: region p95 -> 270ms, p99 -> 930ms, error-rate down to 0.18%. streaming stalls reported by customers dropped significantly.

emma (oncall): moving incident to mitigated->monitoring. but we need RCA. initial hypotheses: (1) request shape skew caused some shards to receive many prefill-heavy requests (long context windows) (2) allocator fragmentation under high churn (3) autoscaler mute due to quota led to insufficient headroom.

marta (customer-success): Customer-B confirmed improvement and asked to be notified when RCA published. they also asked for post-incident timeline and what safeguards will be added.

sasha (eng-runtime): collected diagnostic traces and allocator logs, saving to incident bucket: `s3://incidents/1777000000/artifacts/` . sample lines: `TRACE shard=7 prefill_ops=21045 decode_ops=420 prefill_to_decode=50.1 evictions=1203 frag=0.61 alloc_free=2 largest_free=384KB`

li (eng-sre): planned remediation tasks: short-term: make prefill throttle default under high-eviction conditions, add online compaction job triggerable via runbook; medium-term: rewrite allocator free-list coalescing to reduce fragmentation; infra: request GPU quota increase and add autoscaler fallback policy; product: consider per-customer context caps or signposting.

emma (oncall): who picks up the RCA? Sasha + Li co-own, devin handles quota/runbook. Marta will draft customer-facing summary. I'll handoff incident to Sasha and Li; i'll stay reachable.

sasha (eng-runtime): creating ticket and RCA stub: `/incidents create 1777000000 --owner=sasha --summary "KV fragmentation + prefill hot-shard causing streaming tail latency"`

li (eng-sre): adding retrospective checklist to docs and scheduling postmortem meeting in 48h. Also attaching runbook updates: `docs/runbooks/kv_cache_fragmentation.md` (WIP).

emma (oncall): status: mitigated -> monitoring. leaving thread open for RCA updates. nice job all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident 1777000000 status update: mitigated (monitoring) responders=[emma,sasha,li,devin,marta]
